ns2:course.label: Introductory Poetry Writing
ns2:course.description: (RHET 146) Practice in the writing of poetry; experimentation with a number of fixed forms and free verse, but emphasis mainly on the student's freedom to develop a personal style. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement. Student must petition the Director of Creative Writing to take this course concurrently with RHET 204, RHET 304, or RHET 404.
